title: Vijjā
text: 5. Imesañ ca panāham āvuso catunnaṃ sati- bhā- bahuāsavānaṃ khayā anāsavam cetovimuttim paññāvimuttim diṭṭheva dhamme sayam abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharāmī ti [page 306] 306 Anuruddha-Saṃyuttam LII.
